grammar.explanation: 不是 rejects the first description and 而是 supplies the replacement. Both sides should answer the same implied question.

examples.zh: 这封信不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。
examples.py: zhè fēng xìn bù shì gěi tā de , ér shì gěi tā jiě jie de .
examples.en: This letter is for her sister, not for her.

examples.zh: 我不是不想看，而是今天没时间。
examples.py: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng kàn , ér shì jīn tiān méi shí jiān .
examples.en: It isn’t that I don’t want to watch; I don’t have time today.

commonMistakes.wrong: 这封信不是给她的，而且给她姐姐。
commonMistakes.right: 这封信不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。
commonMistakes.why: 而是 introduces the corrected alternative; 而且 adds another item.

grammar.purpose: Highlight an extreme or unexpected included case
grammar.explanation: Put the especially surprising case after 连. 都 or 也 follows it. The emphasis comes from context, not from an automatic negative meaning.

examples.zh: 你连信封的颜色都记得。
examples.py: nǐ lián xìn fēng de yán sè dōu jì de .
examples.en: You even remember the colour of the envelope.

examples.py: wǒ lián tā de shǒu dōu méi kàn jiàn .
examples.en: I didn’t even notice her hand.

commonMistakes.wrong: 你连都信封的颜色记得。
commonMistakes.right: 你连信封的颜色都记得。
commonMistakes.why: The highlighted phrase belongs between 连 and 都.

grammar.explanation: The first approach is the less preferred one; the second follows 不如. This compares choices rather than measuring one person’s ability against another’s.

examples.zh: 与其听你解释，不如我自己看。
examples.py: yǔ qí tīng nǐ jiě shì , bù rú wǒ zì jǐ kàn .
examples.en: Rather than listening to your explanation, I’d prefer to watch for myself.

examples.zh: 与其一次看完，不如一段一段看。
examples.py: yǔ qí yī cì kàn wán , bù rú yī duàn yī duàn kàn .
examples.en: Rather than watching it all at once, it’s better to watch section by section.

commonMistakes.wrong: 与其我自己看，不如听你解释，所以我决定自己看。
commonMistakes.right: 与其听你解释，不如我自己看。
commonMistakes.why: The chosen approach must follow 不如 in this comparison.

grammar.explanation: 竟然 marks something unexpected. 甚至 adds a case that goes further than what was already stated. Both need a meaningful context, not decoration.

examples.zh: 她竟然记得十年前的那封信。
examples.py: tā jìng rán jì de shí nián qián de nà fēng xìn .
examples.en: She surprisingly remembers that letter from ten years ago.

examples.zh: 他不只记得内容，甚至记得信封的颜色。
examples.py: tā bù zhǐ jì de nèi róng , shèn zhì jì de xìn fēng de yán sè .
examples.en: He remembers not just the contents, but even the envelope’s colour.

commonMistakes.wrong: 他甚至只记得内容，没有更多细节。
commonMistakes.right: 他记得内容，甚至记得信封的颜色。
commonMistakes.why: The 甚至 case should extend the earlier claim, rather than merely restate a limited amount.

dialogue.title: 那封信究竟给谁
dialogue.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
dialogue.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 等一下，刚才她说什么？我只听到一个名字。
lines.py: děng yī xià , gāng cái tā shuō shén me ? wǒ zhǐ tīng dào yī gè míng zi .
lines.en: Wait, what did she say just now? I only caught a name.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她说那封信不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。
lines.py: tā shuō nà fēng xìn bù shì gěi tā de , ér shì gěi tā jiě jie de .
lines.en: She said the letter wasn’t for her; it was for her sister.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那她为什么还打开了？
lines.py: nà tā wèi shén me hái dǎ kāi le ?
lines.en: Then why did she open it anyway?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她先打开才看见里面的名字。你看，信封上没写名字。
lines.py: tā xiān dǎ kāi cái kàn jiàn lǐ miàn de míng zi . nǐ kàn , xìn fēng shàng méi xiě míng zi .
lines.en: She opened it before seeing the name inside. Look, there’s no name on the envelope.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 哦，难怪她的表情突然变了。我以为她生气了。
lines.py: ó , nán guài tā de biǎo qíng tū rán biàn le . wǒ yǐ wéi tā shēng qì le .
lines.en: Oh, that explains why her expression suddenly changed. I thought she was angry.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 未必。她可能只是发现自己弄错了。我们再看一段。
lines.py: wèi bì . tā kě néng zhǐ shì fā xiàn zì jǐ nòng cuò le . wǒ men zài kàn yī duàn .
lines.en: Not necessarily. She may just have realised she was mistaken. Let’s watch a little more.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这个镜头里，桌上好像还有另一封信。
lines.py: zhè gè jìng tóu lǐ , zhuō shàng hǎo xiàng hái yǒu lìng yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: In this shot there seems to be another letter on the table.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对，而且这封已经打开了。姐姐可能早就知道那件事。
lines.py: duì , ér qiě zhè fēng yǐ jīng dǎ kāi le . jiě jie kě néng zǎo jiù zhī dào nà jiàn shì .
lines.en: Yes, and that one is already open. Her sister may have known about it for a while.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你连信封的颜色都记得，我刚才只顾着看她的脸。
lines.py: nǐ lián xìn fēng de yán sè dōu jì de , wǒ gāng cái zhǐ gù zhe kàn tā de liǎn .
lines.en: You even remember the envelope’s colour. I was just watching her face.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我上回看过开头。你先别问最后怎么样，我不会说的。
lines.py: wǒ shàng huí kàn guò kāi tóu . nǐ xiān bié wèn zuì hòu zěn me yàng , wǒ bù huì shuō de .
lines.en: I watched the opening last time. Don’t ask how it ends yet; I’m not telling.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行。与其听你解释，不如我自己看。就是得慢一点。
lines.py: xíng . yǔ qí tīng nǐ jiě shì , bù rú wǒ zì jǐ kàn . jiù shì děi màn yī diǎn .
lines.en: Fine. Rather than having you explain, I’d rather watch for myself. I just need to go a little slower.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那就一次看一段。等你看完，我们再谈这个角色。
lines.py: nà jiù yī cì kàn yī duàn . děng nǐ kàn wán , wǒ men zài tán zhè gè jué sè .
lines.en: Then let’s watch one section at a time. After you’ve finished, we can talk about the character.
lines.speaker: b

questions.q: What are the friends trying to clarify?
choices: Whom the letter was for and why the expression changed
How much the letter cost
Who directed a different programme
questions.answer: Whom the letter was for and why the expression changed

questions.q: What is missing from the envelope?
choices: A name
An address already read aloud
Every piece of paper

questions.q: Why does the experienced viewer refuse to explain the ending?
choices: They want the other friend to watch it first
They have never seen any of the scene

reading.title: 那封信究竟给谁
reading.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
reading.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 第一次看这段戏时，我以为妹妹故意打开姐姐的信。她拿着信沉默了很久，最后只说了一句“原来你早就知道”。
lines.py: dì yī cì kàn zhè duàn xì shí , wǒ yǐ wéi mèi mei gù yì dǎ kāi jiě jie de xìn . tā ná zhe xìn chén mò le hěn jiǔ , zuì hòu zhǐ shuō le yī jù yuán lái nǐ zǎo jiù zhī dào .
lines.en: The first time I watched this scene, I thought the younger sister deliberately opened her sister’s letter. She held it silently for a long time and finally said only, “So you knew all along.”

lines.zh: 后来我重新看了前面的镜头。信封上没有名字，妹妹打开以后，才发现信里称呼的是姐姐。
lines.py: hòu lái wǒ chóng xīn kàn le qián miàn de jìng tóu . xìn fēng shàng méi yǒu míng zi , mèi mei dǎ kāi yǐ hòu , cái fā xiàn xìn lǐ chēng hū de shì jiě jie .
lines.en: Later I rewatched the earlier shots. There was no name on the envelope; only after opening it did the younger sister find it addressed to her older sister.

lines.zh: 桌上另一封信已经打开，旁边还放着姐姐的照片。妹妹看到这些，才说出最后那句话。
lines.py: zhuō shàng lìng yī fēng xìn yǐ jīng dǎ kāi , páng biān hái fàng zhe jiě jie de zhào piān . mèi mei kàn dào zhè xiē , cái shuō chū zuì hòu nà jù huà .
lines.en: Another letter on the table was already open, with a photo of the older sister beside it. The younger sister spoke her final line only after seeing these things.

lines.zh: 这些细节让我改变了对这个角色的印象。她未必是在责怪姐姐，也可能是在难过：姐姐一直知道，却没告诉她。
lines.py: zhè xiē xì jié ràng wǒ gǎi biàn le duì zhè gè jué sè de yìn xiàng . tā wèi bì shì zài zé guài jiě jie , yě kě néng shì zài nán guò : jiě jie yì zhí zhī dào , què méi gào sù tā .
lines.en: These details changed my impression of the character. She wasn’t necessarily blaming her sister; she might also have been hurt that her sister had known all along without telling her.

lines.zh: 不过，戏里没有直接解释姐姐为什么保密。直到下一段，我们才听见姐姐自己的回答。她说自己原来想等妹妹考试结束再谈。
lines.py: bù guò , xì lǐ méi yǒu zhí jiē jiě shì jiě jie wèi shén me bǎo mì . zhí dào xià yī duàn , wǒ men cái tīng jiàn jiě jie zì jǐ de huí dá . tā shuō zì jǐ yuán lái xiǎng děng mèi mei kǎo shì jié shù zài tán .
lines.en: But the scene didn’t directly explain why the older sister had kept it secret. Only in the next section did we hear her answer: she’d wanted to wait until her younger sister’s exams were over before discussing it.

lines.zh: 现在跟朋友谈这段戏，我会先描述看见和听见的细节，再说自己的理解。大家可以有不同看法，回去看看同一个镜头，反而更有意思。
lines.py: xiàn zài gēn péng you tán zhè duàn xì , wǒ huì xiān miáo shù kàn jiàn hé tīng jiàn de xì jié , zài shuō zì jǐ de lǐ jiě . dà jiā kě yǐ yǒu bù tóng kàn fǎ , huí qù kàn kàn tóng yī gè jìng tóu , fǎn ér gèng yǒu yì si .
lines.en: Now when discussing this scene with friends, I describe what I saw and heard before giving my interpretation. We can have different views; returning to the same shot makes it more interesting.

glosses.meaning: address someone by a name or title

choices: Rewatching the letter and photo details
Learning a new actor’s name
Skipping every earlier shot
questions.answer: Rewatching the letter and photo details

questions.q: Why did the older sister say she had waited?
choices: She wanted the younger sister’s exams to finish
She had lost both letters
She had never read any letter
questions.answer: She wanted the younger sister’s exams to finish

questions.q: Which point is presented as an interpretation rather than a direct statement?
choices: The younger sister may feel hurt about not being told
The envelope has no name
The older sister says she waited for the exams
questions.answer: The younger sister may feel hurt about not being told

extraReadings.title: Look at the right-hand side
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 你都看过了，还跟着紧张？
lines.py: nǐ dōu kàn guò le , hái gēn zhe jǐn zhāng ?
lines.en: You’ve already seen it. Why are you still getting nervous?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我看过开头，没看过最后。
lines.py: wǒ kàn guò kāi tóu , méi kàn guò zuì hòu .
lines.en: I’ve seen the opening, not the ending.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那你刚才怎么知道她会打开信？
lines.py: nà nǐ gāng cái zěn me zhī dào tā huì dǎ kāi xìn ?
lines.en: Then how did you know she’d open the letter?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她手都放在信封上了，我也是看出来的。
lines.py: tā shǒu dōu fàng zài xìn fēng shàng le , wǒ yě shì kàn chū lái de .
lines.en: Her hand was already on the envelope. I worked it out from what I saw too.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我连她的手都没看见，光看那张照片了。
lines.py: wǒ lián tā de shǒu dōu méi kàn jiàn , guāng kàn nà zhāng zhào piān le .
lines.en: I didn’t even notice her hand. I was just looking at the photo.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 难怪。你把这段倒回去，看右边。
lines.py: nán guài . nǐ bǎ zhè duàn dào huí qù , kàn yòu biān .
lines.en: That explains it. Go back through this section and look on the right.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。你保密，别先告诉我。
lines.py: hǎo . nǐ bǎo mì , bié xiān gào sù wǒ .
lines.en: Okay. Keep it secret—don’t tell me first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 知道了。今天我连一句多余的话都不说。
lines.py: zhī dào le . jīn tiān wǒ lián yī jù duō yú de huà dōu bù shuō .
lines.en: I know. Today I won’t say even one word more than necessary.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: The letter describes where they first met.

lines.zh: 她把这个秘密告诉了姐姐。
lines.py: tā bǎ zhè gè mì mì gào sù le jiě jie .
lines.en: She told her sister this secret.

lines.zh: 他们准备给朋友过生日，暂时要保守秘密。
lines.py: tā men zhǔn bèi gěi péng you guò shēng rì , zàn shí yào bǎo shǒu mì mì .
lines.en: They’re preparing a birthday celebration for their friend and need to keep it secret for now.

lines.zh: 他太忙了，甚至忘了今天是星期几。
lines.py: tā tài máng le , shèn zhì wàng le jīn tiān shì xīng qī jǐ .
lines.en: He was so busy he even forgot what day it was.

lines.zh: 这段话很难，我甚至听了五遍。
lines.py: zhè duàn huà hěn nán , wǒ shèn zhì tīng le wǔ biàn .
lines.en: This passage is so difficult I listened to it five times.

lines.zh: 这件事先保密，周五再告诉她。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì xiān bǎo mì , zhōu wǔ zài gào sù tā .
lines.en: Keep this quiet for now; we’ll tell her on Friday.

lines.zh: 请替我保密，我想给他一个惊喜。
lines.py: qǐng tì wǒ bǎo mì , wǒ xiǎng gěi tā yī gè jīng xǐ .
lines.en: Please keep this secret for me; I want to surprise him.

lines.zh: 她在这部电影里的表演很出色。
lines.py: tā zài zhè bù diàn yǐng lǐ de biǎo yǎn hěn chū sè .
lines.en: Her performance in this film is excellent.

lines.zh: 他出色地完成了第一次演出。
lines.py: tā chū sè de wán chéng le dì yī cì yǎn chū .
lines.en: He did an excellent job in his first performance.

lines.zh: 这个故事的后半段很沉重。
lines.py: zhè gè gù shì de hòu bàn duàn hěn chén zhòng .
lines.en: The second half of this story is emotionally heavy.

lines.zh: 他带着沉重的心情离开了医院。
lines.py: tā dài zhe chén zhòng de xīn qíng lí kāi le yī yuàn .
lines.en: He left the hospital feeling weighed down.

lines.zh: 这回我终于听懂她为什么笑了。
lines.py: zhè huí wǒ zhōng yú tīng dǒng tā wèi shén me xiào le .
lines.en: This time I finally understood why she laughed.

lines.zh: 上回你说这家店关了，现在又开了吗？
lines.py: shàng huí nǐ shuō zhè jiā diàn guān le , xiàn zài yòu kāi le ma ?
lines.en: Last time you said this shop had closed. Has it reopened?

lines.zh: 这一段只有两个人说话。
lines.py: zhè yī duàn zhǐ yǒu liǎng gè rén shuō huà .
lines.en: Only two people speak in this section.

lines.zh: 把最后一段再放一遍吧。
lines.py: bǎ zuì hòu yī duàn zài fàng yī biàn ba .
lines.en: Please play the last section again.

lines.zh: 她听到名字以后，反应很奇怪。
lines.py: tā tīng dào míng zi yǐ hòu , fǎn yìng hěn qí guài .
lines.en: Her reaction after hearing the name was strange.

lines.zh: 我的反应慢了一点，没接上他的玩笑。
lines.py: wǒ de fǎn yìng màn le yī diǎn , méi jiē shàng tā de wán xiào .
lines.en: I reacted a little slowly and missed his joke.

lines.zh: 他在比赛中的表现比上次好多了。
lines.py: tā zài bǐ sài zhōng de biǎo xiàn bǐ shàng cì hǎo duō le .
lines.en: His performance in the competition was much better than last time.

lines.zh: 她没有表现出不高兴。
lines.py: tā méi yǒu biǎo xiàn chū bù gāo xìng .
lines.en: She didn’t show that she was unhappy.

lines.zh: 演出结束，观众都站起来鼓掌。
lines.py: yǎn chū jié shù , guān zhòng dōu zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng .
lines.en: At the end of the performance, the audience stood and applauded.

lines.zh: 观众最想知道的是信里写了什么。
lines.py: guān zhòng zuì xiǎng zhī dào de shì xìn lǐ xiě le shén me .
lines.en: What the audience most wants to know is what the letter says.

lines.zh: 这两封信的内容不一样。
lines.py: zhè liǎng fēng xìn de nèi róng bù yī yàng .
lines.en: The contents of these two letters differ.

lines.zh: 标题很短，内容却有好几页。
lines.py: biāo tí hěn duǎn , nèi róng què yǒu hǎo jǐ yè .
lines.en: The title is short, but the content runs to several pages.

lines.zh: 她以为信是给自己的，结果闹了个误会。
lines.py: tā yǐ wéi xìn shì gěi zì jǐ de , jié guǒ nào le gè wù huì .
lines.en: She thought the letter was for her, which caused a misunderstanding.

lines.zh: 这个误会到最后才解释清楚。
lines.py: zhè gè wù huì dào zuì hòu cái jiě shì qīng chǔ .
lines.en: This misunderstanding is only cleared up at the end.

conversation.title: Follow the letter, not just the face
conversation.context: You missed a line and need to work out whom the letter is addressed to.
conversation.goal: Recover a missed line from an original drama scene

partner.name: 陈宇
partner.persona: A familiar classmate; friendly, brief replies.

examples: 不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。
accept: ^不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。[。！？]?$

turns.pinyin: tā wèi shén me chén mò ?
turns.intent: Offer an interpretation as a possibility
examples: 她可能是难过，不一定是生气。
accept: ^她可能是难过，不一定是生气。[。！？]?$

turns.text: 要不要我告诉你最后怎么样？
turns.pinyin: yào bù yào wǒ gào sù nǐ zuì hòu zěn me yàng ?
turns.meaning: Shall I tell you how it ends?
turns.intent: Decline the spoiler and ask to watch first

natural.zh: 刚才那句话我没听清，能倒回去吗？
natural.py: gāng cái nà jù huà wǒ méi tīng qīng , néng dào huí qù ma ?
natural.en: I didn’t catch that line. Could we go back?

pragmatics.note: Ask for the missing span; hearing a sound and understanding its implication are different tasks.

pragmatics.situation: Offer a reading of a character

natural.zh: 我觉得她可能有点难过。
natural.py: wǒ jué de tā kě néng yǒu diǎn nán guò .
natural.en: I think she might feel a little hurt.

pragmatics.note: 我觉得 and 可能 keep the interpretation distinct from an explicit line in the scene.

audio.zh: 她说那封信不是给她的，而是给她姐姐的。
audio.py: tā shuō nà fēng xìn bù shì gěi tā de , ér shì gěi tā jiě jie de .
audio.en: She said the letter wasn’t for her; it was for her sister.

tasks.statement: The letter is addressed to the younger sister herself.
tasks.why: It is for her older sister.

audio.zh: 不过，戏里没有直接解释姐姐为什么保密。直到下一段，我们才听见姐姐自己的回答。她说自己原来想等妹妹考试结束再谈。
audio.py: bù guò , xì lǐ méi yǒu zhí jiē jiě shì jiě jie wèi shén me bǎo mì . zhí dào xià yī duàn , wǒ men cái tīng jiàn jiě jie zì jǐ de huí dá . tā shuō zì jǐ yuán lái xiǎng děng mèi mei kǎo shì jié shù zài tán .
audio.en: But the scene didn’t directly explain why the older sister had kept it secret. Only in the next section did we hear her answer: she’d wanted to wait until her younger sister’s exams were over before discussing it.

tasks.statement: The older sister says she wanted to wait until the exams finished.
tasks.why: This is reported as her own explanation.

prompt.zh: 我想自己看完再聊。你现在要直接告诉我结尾吗？
prompt.py: wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ kàn wán zài liáo . nǐ xiàn zài yào zhí jiē gào sù wǒ jié wěi ma ?
prompt.en: I want to watch it myself before discussing it. Are you going to tell me the ending now?

choices: 先不说，你看完我们再聊。
不用看了，我现在把最后一幕讲完。
可以，你已经说想先听结尾。
tasks.answer: 先不说，你看完我们再聊。
tasks.why: The reply preserves the friend’s chance to watch first.

prompt.zh: 只看见她看信封后没说话，我以为她生气了。
prompt.py: zhǐ kàn jiàn tā kàn xìn fēng hòu méi shuō huà , wǒ yǐ wéi tā shēng qì le .
prompt.en: I only saw her stop speaking after looking at the envelope, and assumed she was angry.

choices: 未必，她也可能只是发现弄错了。
没说话就一定是生气，不用再看。
没听见她说原因，就已经知道全部了。
tasks.answer: 未必，她也可能只是发现弄错了。
tasks.why: The reply gives a possible alternative without claiming certainty.

line.zh: 这封信不是给她的，【而是】给她姐姐的。
line.py: zhè fēng xìn bù shì gěi tā de , ér shì gěi tā jiě jie de .
line.en: This letter is for her sister, not for her.

line.zh: 你【连】信封的颜色都记得。
line.py: nǐ lián xìn fēng de yán sè dōu jì de .
line.en: You even remember the envelope’s colour.
